name: Magboro
discoveryMethod: Separate first-party English and Yoruba discovery, official Ogun State portal review, GeoNode page/configuration inspection, bounded anonymous GeoNode API listing, and an ordinary TLS-verified OGPRS request.
queryOutcomes: English discovery found Ogun State Land Admin/e-GIS, OLARMS, the Ogun SDI GeoNode catalogue, OGPRS, and the federal cadastral authority. Yoruba discovery found no distinct first-party local-language parcel route. The public SDI catalogue exposed GeoNode API v2 and a GeoServer base URL, but the bounded resource listing did not expose a Magboro parcel dataset or parcel-feature response. OGPRS search material describes property polygons/PIDs, but its host certificate was expired and was not bypassed.

attempts.outcome: First-party Ogun State and federal survey routes found; no verified Magboro public parcel API found.

attempts.outcome: No distinct first-party Yoruba cadastral viewer or Magboro parcel API found; official English Ogun State routes were the relevant results.
Official Ogun State portal loaded and linked Land Admin/e-GIS, OLARMS, Office of the Surveyor General, and planning routes; no parcel feature service was exposed in the page.

Official GeoNode catalogue loaded. Current JavaScript/configuration exposed default map CRS EPSG:3857, GeoNode API v2 at /api/v2/, and GeoServer public base URL https://geoserver.ogunstate.gov.ng/geoserver/.
Bounded anonymous resource listing returned 61 total resources and a first page containing maps/documents; no Magboro parcel dataset, native parcel schema, or feature geometry response was obtained.
TLS certificate verification failed because the certificate was expired. No retry with verification disabled was made; no OGPRS API or geometry was requested.
Federal official page loaded and described cadastral/legal survey and cadastral GIS responsibilities nationwide; no public Magboro parcel endpoint was exposed.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: No Magboro-specific local registry custodian was evidenced. Ogun State land-administration/GIS agencies and the federal Surveyor-General are general custodial authorities, not proof of a city-specific public parcel service.
sourceAssessment.publicService: The Ogun SDI GeoNode catalogue/API is the strongest public source candidate, but its bounded anonymous listing did not yield a Magboro parcel layer or feature response. OGPRS is an official property-identification route by description, but unavailable under normal TLS verification during this attempt.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: No parcel-layer fields or native parcel identifiers were exposed in the inspected responses. OGPRS descriptive material mentions PID for property polygons, but no response was retrieved to verify field semantics or geometry.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if a future official parcel feature response exposes one
scopeLimits: The state and federal authority pages do not establish Magboro-wide parcel coverage.
The GeoNode API listing was bounded and did not enumerate a verified parcel dataset; absence from that listing is not evidence of cadastral absence.
The observed EPSG:3857 value is the portal default map CRS, not a parcel-layer CRS.
The OGPRS TLS failure is an availability finding; certificate verification was not bypassed.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI would not establish citywide absence; no such absence inference was made.
No GeoJSON sample is included because no unchanged native parcel geometry with a safe native identity was obtained.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: Ogun State's official GIS/land-administration ecosystem is established, but Magboro-specific public parcel coverage, service routes, native identity fields, parcel CRS, geometry access, and adapter qualification remain unresolved.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
